searchText: We should plan ahead but at the same time we'll also increase bandwidth needs of L1 nodes in the near future by increasing block sizes through gas limit increases + adding a BAL. My feeling is that we should observe how the network does after glam and can then still discuss more blobs. Right now, I'd prefer to have that bandwidth for L1, and I don't think, if propagation doesn't improve significantly, that there's much room.

excerpts.author: nero_eth
excerpts.content:
We should plan ahead but at the same time we'll also increase bandwidth needs of L1 nodes in the near future by increasing block sizes through gas limit increases + adding a BAL.
My feeling is that we should observe how the network does after glam and can then still discuss more blobs. Right now, I'd prefer to have that bandwidth for L1, and I don't think, if propagation doesn't improve significantly, that there's much room.
